issues.quote: Because Agnes outraged Anna beyond belief.

All the more so since Theodore's reports and elective transcripts, assigned by Agnes to torment Theodore, much to Anna's displeasure, the curator simply flicked into the wastebasket with a wave of her gold nails.
assigned by Agnes to torment Theodore
Because right now, in Agnes's office, she and Theodore were discussing Anna's future.
smoking out the window at the same time
Agnes said her tête-à-têtes with Theodore were where she relaxed; he needed curating least of all, she claimed.
he needed curating least of all
Though in truth she gave them everything she had.
